arguments.summary: The p99 latency spike coincides with the connection pool refresh, so the issue is likely related to pgbouncer. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and the export of the failed_jobs table is in progress using pg_dump. The pgbouncer service is currently in a degraded state with 100% of connections in use and no worker throughput.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Continue monitoring the pgbouncer service and the failed_jobs export. Once the export is complete, review the data to understand the reasons behind the job failures and take appropriate actions to resolve the backlog. Additionally, investigate the root cause of the pgbouncer degradation and ensure the connection pool is configured correctly to prevent future issues.
